name: Parabolic Ray Tracing in Heterogeneous Media
definition: A method to trace rays in a medium with spatially varying Refractive Index Field (RIF) by modeling the RIF such that ray trajectories are second-order polynomials within tetrahedral cells. This allows exact intersection computation with cell boundaries via quadratic equations.
summary: Parabolic Ray Tracing computes light trajectories in heterogeneous media by approximating ray paths as second-order polynomials within tetrahedral cells, enabling exact boundary intersections via quadratic equations.
